anyOf.description: Switch off a setting inherited from a broader layer.

oneOf.description: Embedded in-process WAL + WebAssembly rules (VPS, container, local dev).
Remote HTTP dimeDB server (AWS Lambda, Vercel, edge, multi-node).

Duration.description: A duration like "30s", "5m", "250ms" or "1h30m", or a number of seconds.

oneOf.description: Only tools whose `auth` scopes the caller's token has.
Every tool. Calls are still checked.

Listen.description: Where an `http` runtime's server listens for Unsworn.

oneOf.description:
A Unix socket only Unsworn's user can open, at the path in
`UNSWORN_SOCKET`. Nothing else can reach the server.

A port on this machine that Unsworn picks, in `PORT`, for a server
that can't listen on a socket. Anything on the machine can reach it.

anyOf.description: Switch off a setting inherited from a broader layer.

oneOf.description: Let requests through without counting them.
Tier 2: length-prefixed frames over a Unix socket.

An HTTP server of the runtime's own: any language's, with no SDK.
Unsworn starts it and forwards requests to it once they've passed
their route's rules. Routes reach it with `proxy = { runtime = ... }`.

RawAuth.description:
`auth` as written: `"jwt"`, `"none"`, `["jwt", "service"]`,
`{ scheme = "jwt", scopes = [...] }`, or a list of those.

url.description: A JWKS document with the verification keys.

cache.description:
How long to remember the verifier's answer for a key, in `[store]`.
Default: not cached.

header.description: The request header that carries the key.

headers.description: Headers sent to `url`, such as its own credentials.

keys.description: The valid keys: a list, or a comma-separated string.

query.description: The query parameter that carries the key.

timeout.description: How long to wait for `url` before answering `503`. Default: 2s.

url.description:
An OAuth 2.0 token introspection endpoint (RFC 7662) that verifies
keys, instead of `keys`.

oneOf.description: A scheme for requests a service signs with a shared secret.

encoding.description: How that header writes it: `hex` (the default) or `base64`.

header.description:
Or, for any other: the header that holds an HMAC-SHA256 of the
body.

prefix.description: Text in front of it, such as `sha256=`.

provider.description:
A service whose way of signing Unsworn knows: `stripe`, `github`,
`slack`, `standard` (Standard Webhooks) or `svix`.

secret.description: The secret the service signs with.

tolerance.description:
How far a signed time may be from now, for the providers that sign
one. Default: 5 minutes.

anyOf.description: Switch off a setting inherited from a broader layer.
Switch off a setting inherited from a broader layer.

RawDimeDb.description:
`[dimedb]`: durable transactional state with at-most-once `request_id`s,
`lookup`, `ctx.call` functions, and automatic MCP tools.

fuel_per_check.description: Optional Wasmtime fuel budget per `check` call (default: 200_000).

lookup_window.description: Lookup window for expired request IDs (e.g. `"1h"`).

mcp.description: Expose commands, `lookup`, and table reads as MCP tools when `[mcp]` is set.

prefix.description: Prefix for generated `ctx.call` functions and MCP tools. Default: `"dimedb"`.

retry_window.description: Retry window for UUIDv7 request IDs (e.g. `"10m"`).

schema.description: Path to `dimedb.toml`, relative to the project root.

RawFunction.description: A `[[function]]`: a handler other handlers call with `ctx.call`.

input.description:
A JSON Schema for the input: a file path or an inline table. The
input is checked against it before the function runs.

name.description: What callers call it by: letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`.

output.description: A JSON Schema for what it answers with.

runtime.description: The runtime, when the handler file's extension doesn't say.

timeout.description:
The longest a call may take. Default: `[server].timeout`. A call
also ends when the request it's made for runs out of time.

RawGen.description:
`[gen]`: where `unsworn gen` and `unsworn dev` write each language's
types, relative to the project directory.

go.description:
Go: a path, or `{ file = "...", package = "..." }` when the file
isn't in package `main`.

anyOf.description: Switch off a setting inherited from a broader layer.
Switch off a setting inherited from a broader layer.

RawMcp.description: The `[mcp]` table: one MCP endpoint and its tools.

instructions.description: Guidance for the model on how to use this server's tools.

list_ttl.description:
How long clients may cache `tools/list` and `server/discover`
results. Default: 5m.

name.description: The server name reported to clients. Default: `unsworn`.

proxy.description: An existing MCP server to forward to. Tools then only add policies.

title.description: A display name for the server.

version.description: The server version reported to clients. Default: the Unsworn version.

input.description: JSON Schema for the arguments: a file, or an inline table.

output.description: JSON Schema for structured results: a file, or an inline table.

mcp_tools.description: Which operations are also MCP tools: `"all"`, or `{ tags = [...] }`.

anyOf.description: `{ tags = ["public"] }`: operations with any of these tags.
Switch off a setting inherited from a broader layer.

RawOutbound.description:
`[outbound.<name>]`: a service handlers reach with `ctx.fetch(name, ...)`.
Unsworn makes the request and adds `headers`, so a handler never holds
the service's credential.

headers.description:
Headers added to every request, replacing any a handler sets by the
same name: `{ Authorization = "Bearer {env.STRIPE_KEY}" }`. The
variables read here aren't passed to workers.

methods.description: Methods a handler may use. Default: any.

paths.description:
Paths a handler may ask for, as route patterns such as
"/v1/charges/{id}" or "/v1/customers/{*rest}". Default: any.

timeout.description: The longest a request may take. Default: `[server].timeout`.

url.description:
Where the service is, such as "https://api.stripe.com". A handler's
path goes after it. May use `{env.NAME}`.

RawParam.description: One inline parameter rule: `{ type = "integer", min = 1 }`.

RawPolicies.description:
Policy keys, as used in `[defaults]` and `[policies.*]`. Route entries
repeat these fields.

require.description:
Pairs of values that have to be the same, such as
`{ "params.org" = "auth.org" }`.

response_headers.description: Headers to set on, or remove from, the response.

stream_body.description:
Pass the request body to the handler as it arrives, instead of
reading it first.

context.description:
Whether the upstream is told who the caller is, in the
`Unsworn-Context` header. Default: true.

runtime.description: Or an `http` runtime, whose server Unsworn starts itself.

upstreams.description: Where to forward: one or more URLs, or `unix:/path`.

anyOf.description: Switch off a setting inherited from a broader layer.

What an unquoted dotted key turns into: `params.org = "auth.org"`
is `{ params = { org = "auth.org" } }`.

headers.description: Rules for request headers, by name.

invalidates.description:
Paths whose cached responses a successful request to this route
makes out of date, such as `["/users/{id}", "/users"]`.

mcp.description: Offer the route as an MCP tool too.

require.description:
Pairs of values that have to be the same, such as
`{ "params.org" = "auth.org" }`.

response_headers.description: Headers to set on, or remove from, the response.

shadow.description:
A second handler that gets a copy of each request, to compare with
the route's own: a handler reference, or `{ handler, runtime, sample }`.
Clients only ever get the route's own answer.

stream_body.description:
Pass the request body to the handler as it arrives, instead of
reading it first.

RawRouteTool.description:
`mcp = { tool = "get_user", description = "..." }` on a `[[route]]`:
the route is also an MCP tool, with arguments built from its contract.

description.description:
What the tool does. Defaults to the OpenAPI operation's summary or
description.

method.description: The method tool calls use, for a route that accepts several.

calls.description:
The `[[function]]`s and `[outbound.<name>]` services an `http`
runtime's server may call through Unsworn, by name, or `["*"]` for
all of them. Default: none, so it isn't given the endpoint and its
requests carry no `Unsworn-Call` token.

extensions.description:
The file extensions of the handlers it runs. An `http` runtime
has none: routes name it.

listen.description: Where an `http` runtime's server listens. Default: `"socket"`.

workers.description:
How many worker processes: a number for exactly that many, or
`{ min, max }` to start `min` and add more under load. Default:
one, growing to the number of CPUs available.

idle_timeout.description: How long a kept-alive connection may wait for its next request.

listen.description:
The address to serve on. Default: "0.0.0.0:8080", or
"127.0.0.1:8080" under `unsworn dev`, whose detailed errors are for
this machine only.

max_connections.description: The most connections held open at once. More wait to be accepted.

trusted_proxies.description: Proxies whose `X-Forwarded-For` header is trusted: CIDRs, or `"all"`.

runtime.description: The runtime, when the handler file's extension doesn't say.

sample.description: The share of requests to copy, from 0 to 1. Default: 1, all of them.

on_error.description: What rate limits do when the store can't be reached.

prefix.description: Prepended to every key, so separate projects can share one Redis.

token.description: The REST API's token, with an `https://` `url`.

url.description:
For the `redis` backend: `redis://` or `rediss://` (TLS), or the
`https://` URL of a Redis REST API (Upstash's protocol), which is
how serverless functions reach Redis.

RawTelemetry.description:
`[telemetry]`: where Unsworn sends spans, and of how many requests. It
has no URL of its own: spans only go to a declared outbound service.

logs.description:
Whether the server's logs are sent too, worker output included, with
`POST /v1/logs`, which the service must then allow. Default: false.

metrics.description:
Whether the server's metrics are sent too, with `POST /v1/metrics`,
which the service must then allow. Default: false.

outbound.description:
The name of the `[outbound.<name>]` that spans are sent to over
OTLP/HTTP. It must allow `POST /v1/traces`.

sample.description:
The share of requests that are recorded, from 0 to 1. One from a
proxy in `[server].trusted_proxies` that has a `traceparent` follows
its sampled flag instead. Default: 0.

service_name.description:
The service name on the spans. Default: `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, then
"unsworn".

RawToolAnnotations.description: Hints about a tool's behavior, for clients. Not enforced.

destructive.description: The tool may delete or overwrite data.

idempotent.description: Calling the tool again with the same arguments has no further effect.

open_world.description: The tool reaches systems outside this server, such as the web.

idle.description:
How long a worker the others could do without is kept before it's
retired. Default: "30s".

max.description: The most to run. Default: the number of CPUs available.

min.description: How many to start, and keep when there's little to do. Default: 1.

SchemaRef.description: A JSON Schema reference: a file path, or an inline schema table.

Size.description: A size like "1MB" or "512KB" (1024-based), or a number of bytes.

oneOf.description: In this process only. Fine for a single instance.
Shared by every instance that uses the same Redis (or Valkey, Dragonfly...).

dimedb.description: Durable, in-memory transactional state backed by dimeDB.

function.description:
Handlers that other handlers call by name. Nothing outside reaches
them.

gen.description: Files of typed request models to write for handlers, by language.

mcp.description: A remote MCP server: tools as handlers, or policies for a proxied one.

outbound.description: Services Unsworn calls for handlers, adding each one's credential.

telemetry.description: OpenTelemetry traces, sent to one of the `outbound` services.
